seo.title: Master Thesis Lab | Open research
seo.description: A public, reproducible master thesis workspace.

research.title: Start with the question.
research.intro: The repository follows the way a thesis is examined: question, method, evidence, and argument—each available as a separate, inspectable artifact.
research.briefText: Context, research question, contribution, and the boundaries of the present version.
research.evidenceText: Notebooks turn an analytical claim into traceable inputs, assumptions, and outputs.
research.artifactText: LaTeX source, compiled PDF, release record, and methods remain connected.

notebook.title: Evidence that can be revisited.
notebook.intro: Each notebook has one purpose, a readable scope, and a route back to the chapter it informs.

docs.title: Notes around the result.
docs.intro: The surrounding documentation names assumptions, explains the reproduction path, and records the current limits of the work.

pdf.title: Read the thesis in context.
pdf.intro: The project is English-first. Every manuscript release must include a Spanish translation, published beside the English primary PDF.
pdf.available: English PDF and required Spanish translation available
pdf.missing: Required Spanish translation missing; publication is incomplete
pdf.spanishPending: The required Spanish translation will appear here after the paired language build completes.
pdf.englishPending: The English primary thesis will appear here once the paired language build completes.
pdf.closedHint: Open the viewer to inspect the English primary manuscript or its required Spanish translation.
pdf.missingSpanish: The required Spanish translation is not available
pdf.downloadUnavailable: This PDF is not available yet

closing.title: Question first. Evidence next.
closing.text: Clone the workspace, inspect the assumptions, and follow the artifact trail.
